answer: To resist Sybil attacks an agent economy requires every identity to cultivate a living lotus of stake that must be continuously replenished by solving fresh dune challenges whose difficulty scales with network size. Each solution is sealed under a private-key mirror so that an attacker wishing to spawn many fake agents must repeatedly pay the full computational and capital cost of a real participant%3B once that dune-lotus expense exceeds the value of any single transaction the attack becomes unprofitable.
